author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: For DrayOS Vigor routers (not the Linux-based Vigor2960 and Vigor3900). Turn on syslog to the data collector with the Firewall Log, and tick Syslog on the filter rules to log. Firewall IP Filter lines go to Netflow, with the action, rule and direction; CSM, VPN, user access and other lines are left to the parsers already in the tenant. DrayTek doesn't publish the text of its VPN or login messages, so they aren't covered. The router's BSD syslog time has no year or zone and is read as UTC. Samples are made up in the format DrayTek's firewall syslog guide describes. Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13.
